scope: Focused actual-cookie route/session blocker slice across Resident, Treasurer, Chairman, and System Admin routes

blockerSpecificMatrix.evidence: Nine principal categories crossed against all four representative handler families using actual Better Auth cookies or anonymous requests; correct-role and other-RT scoped reads succeed, wrong-role/stale/anonymous requests are denied, and recovery/database snapshots remain unchanged on denial. Adjacent route tests preserve positive Resident, Treasurer verification, Chairman waiver, and System Admin recovery paths.
blockerSpecificMatrix.systemAdminAudit: NOT_APPLICABLE; no audit API route exists under src/app/api and admin tooling is deferred F17

sessionAuthenticity: Better Auth sessions and signed cookies were created through local email login and System Admin TOTP flows. Route handlers and principal resolution are real; tests inject Next request-header context to invoke handlers directly, so this is not browser coverage.

tdd.red: Before the route guard, a foreign-Origin POST with a verified System Admin cookie returned HTTP 200 and completed the recovery route instead of the expected 403.
tdd.green: After adding the shared isSameOriginRequest guard before body parsing/authentication, foreign, missing, null, and malformed Origin cases returned 403 without state changes. Expanded route tests pass.

treasurerRoutes.paymentRequestVerify: Treasurer 200; one payment and one allocation created; due paid

remainingGaps: No two-origin browser harness was run to observe cross-site cookie delivery.
Successful cash payment, reversal, household lifecycle, fee-rate, and adjustment mutations were not exercised in this focused matrix; their denial and safe no-op/error paths were exercised.
Payment-history actual-cookie coverage, authenticated Resident payment-request create success, and successful lifecycle/fee/adjustment/cash/reversal mutations remain uncovered.
The broader S1-S16 threat plan remains incomplete for fixation, brute-force boundaries, PIN lockout, full browser CSRF proof, and the separately assigned concurrency suite.
System Admin recovery target inactive/foreign, malformed reference, and audit-failure rollback do not have a complete HTTP-level cookie matrix.
